title: goAML Registration Procedure
content:
What are the documents required for goAML registration

The following documents are required for goAML registration:

-The organisation’s Authorisation Letter in favour of the designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer

-A copy of the passport, resident visa, and Emirates ID of the Compliance Officer

-  A copy of the organization’s commercial trade license

The following documents are required for goAML registration:

  • The organisation’s Authorisation Letter in favour of the designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer

  • A copy of the passport, resident visa, and Emirates ID of the Compliance Officer

  • A copy of the organization’s commercial trade license

In addition to the documents, the organization must also download the ‘Google Authenticator’ application on the mobile of the registered contact number.

UAE goAML

Registration Type

The goAML Portal offers three types of goAML registration, as prescribed by the UAE’s Financial Intelligence Unit:

  • Reporting Entity

  • Stakeholder

  • Supervisory Body

Financial Institutions (FIs), VASPs, and DNFBPs must register on the goAML Portal with Registration Type “Reporting Entities”.

STEPS TO REGISTER ON THE goAML PORTAL

Step-by-Step goAML Registration Process

The goAML registration is a two-stage process:

Register in the Service Access Control Manager (SACM) system of the UAE FIU to get Username and the Secret Key for accessing Google Authenticator.

01

Registration on the UAE FIU’s goAML Portal, furnishing information about the organization and the Compliance Officer.

02

Stage 1 of goAML Registration: SACM and Obtaining the Secret Key

The first stage is registering the entity to get the username and the SECRET CODE to access the Google Authenticator application on the mobile device.

  1. Access

    Govservices.uaefiu.gov.ae/sacm/registration.php﻿ and complete this form, attaching the documents mentioned above.

goAML Pre-registration Phase Guide – Key considerations to be taken care of while registering on SACM:

  • Mandatory fields marked with (*) must be completed

  • Select “Registration Type” as Reporting Entity

  • Appropriate Supervisory Authority must be selected

  • Under “ID Number/Reg. No.” captures the License Number as mentioned in the Trade License

  • Phone number and email address must be entered accurately to receive OTPs

  • Attachment of the supporting documents is allowed in PDF only

  • The documents to be uploaded – Authorization Letter, Trade/Commercial License, copy of Passport, Emirates ID and Residence Visa – must be merged and uploaded as a single pdf file

  • Do not forget to TICK the acceptance of the “goAML Portal Service Terms and Conditions” block

  • Ensure that the e-mail IDs are whitelisted – no-reply.sacm@uaefiu.gov.ae and no-reply.goaml@uaefiu.gov.ae

Upon submission of this form, you will receive an email on the registered email ID, capturing the Email OTP and URL to access the username and the Secret Key for setting up the Google Authenticator application.

The OTP is valid for 24 hours only.

Set up Google Authenticator

Install the Google Authenticator application on the mobile, with a contact number registered on the SACM.

Now create an account on the application, capturing the following details:

  • Capture the Account Name as “goAML Portal”.

  • Under Your Key field, enter the Secret Key received via email.

 

unique “Org ID”, which is each organization’s unique goAML identity number.

 

Stage 2 of goAML Registration: Completing goAML Registration

Now, complete the goAML registration.

  1. Access ﻿﻿ and log in using the username received post-SACM registration and a 6-digit code on the Google Authenticator as a Password.

  1. Upon Sign In, you will be directed to the goAML homepage.

  2. Initiate the registration by clicking “Register as a New organization”.

  3. goAML Registration Phase Guide – Key considerations to be taken care of while registering on FIU’s goAML Portal:

    • Select “Registration Type” as Reporting Entity

    • Mandatory fields marked with (*) must be completed

    • Accurately furnish organizational details and the details about the Compliance Officer

    • If you face any issues while registering, you can write to goAML@uaefiu.gov.ae

  4. Wait for email conﬁrmation about the approval of your registration application, and you will get a unique “Org ID”, which is each organization’s uniquegoAML identity number.

title: How to Apply for VAT Clearance Certificate
content:
Apply Through FTA Portal

Steps:

  1. Go to https://eservices.tax.gov.ae/#/Logon

  2. Log in to your EmaraTax account

  3. Go to Other servies before you enter to the company

  4. Choose “Clearance Certificate”

  5. Select appropriate Reason

  6. Upload Upload scanned copy of financial statement from the issue date till today & Upload scanned copy of Declaration letter that the Mandatory threshold will not be reached in the next 30 days

  7. Submit the request

  8.  You can download the certificate directly from the EmaraTax dashboard once approved.
